name: Rintaro Okabe

names.ja: 岡部 倫太郎 (おかべ りんたろう)

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, comrade. Are you ready for the operation? This mission's objective is—the cafeteria!

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Pfhaaaah~ Feels great to have a bottle of Dr.P in the afternoon... Would you like a bottle too, comrade?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: This, this is sushi... and this... is this gyutan-don?! Omnomnom... It's good! For us in the lab whose daily rations are cup noodles... omnomnom... This is really good too!

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: The night is silent and alone, truly suited to an insane mad scientist like myself. O comrade of mine, let us begin an experiment to take over the world...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: White coats are the best after all. It's as though inspiration wells up from the depths of my brain. Hm? You prefer gas masks and fatigues? Heresy!

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: ...I didn't expect conducting the experiment on the cloud to produce gelbanas too... Oh?! You're just in time, my comrade. There's an interesting dish here, would you like to try it?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Yes, it's me. To think the Organization has already infiltrated the cloud... My comrade and I will carry on the mission to the very last moment...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: O comrade, I have an idea for a new future gadget. Hm? You want a demonstration... Alright, we'll meet at the old place at 14:30. Stay hidden, got that?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Hehehe... Welcome to my Future Gadget Laboratory!

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: El Psy Kongroo~

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: "Rintaro Okabe" is merely an alias I use to disguise my identity in real life. I am the insane mad scientist... HOUOUIN—KYOUMA—!

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Duty?! Eh... I'll go browse @ch for a bit.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Muhahaha! My name is Hououin Kyouma, one who longs for chaos, the insane mad scientist who will overturn the ruling order of this world! My comrade, allow me to lend you a hand.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Muhahaha! Tremble, o cloud server, and look upon me in awe, Magrasea! The world is mine!

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Muhahaha! Now is the time to create chaos and shatter the ruling order of the world.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: At last, I've done it! Is this the choice of Steins Gate... El Psy Kongroo...

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Deploy? Is Ragnarok upon us at last?

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Commence Operation Minerva!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Kneel before the might of Steins Gate!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: All this is the choice of Steins Gate!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: My name is Hououin Kyouma! The world is in the palm of my hand!

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: Even if it didn't work this time, I'm sure it will on my next try... No matter how many tries it takes!

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Steins... Ah, no! Neural Cloud!

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
Is, is this the Ops Room? Uwah! And there are... there's guns, and even laser cannons too?! 
(Clears throat) Well, I'm used to seeing such things. After all, back in my world, I was an insane mad scientist...
Daru... Lend me your shoulder. No, I'm not scared! Don't ask, just lend me your shoulder! My knees are about to give out!

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: So you've come to the roof for a walk as well, comrade? Heh... I was just thinking about the past. It was when I was building the Future Gadgets Lab and only Daru and Mayuri were around. Now, I have so many friends by my side...  It's strange isn't it? It's thanks to them that all the effort I've put in for so long feels like it's paid off. You think the same way too, right?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: Hm? Why do I call you my comrade? Is that not obvious? We once fought side by side in another world, and here... You are my accomplice in fooling the world. This is a bond beyond acquaintances or friends... and so the only word for someone who has surpassed those definitions is "my comrade".

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Comrade, do you still remember? Back then, when we... No, it's nothing. I was simply recalling what you told me in the other world... Something that only one person can clearly remember, and which does not exist in the memories of anyone else... Truly, that is a painful thing. (Sigh) Such is the lot of the lonely observer's life, I guess.
Still, at least I am no longer alone in this place. Let us bear the memories of this world line together. Isn't that right... my comrade?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
The insane mad scientist, Steins Gate... They're nothing more than make-believe. I know that very well myself. But these chuuni delusions are my weapons and armor which have allowed me to help and save the people important to me in countless critical situations.
How's that? It was a cool line, right? O comrade of mine, don't make such a pitying face... Still, you understand me, right? After all, you're just like me, playing a role to protect the people important to you, are you not?

voices.label: Sympathy
voices.text: Hehehe... That's it.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Urgh...

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Ah... Ehhh?!

voices.label: Live2D
voices.text: El Psy Kongroo...

career:
Rintaro Okabe hails from Akihabara, Japan, in the 2010s. He is a freshman at Tokyo Denki University.

A self-proclaimed mad scientist going by the name of "Hououin Kyouma" who is engaged in constant battles with the "Organization" which secretly rules the world and only exists within his delusions. His catchphrase is "El Psy Kongroo". Investigation has revealed that he suffers from "eight-grader syndrome" or "chuunibyou", hence his roleplaying with the abovementioned backstory and "character details", as well as his penchant for randomly inserting terms from urban legends and Norse mythology into his speech. In terms of both intellectual and physical abilities, Rintaro Okabe is no different from an ordinary human being.

He founded the Future Gadgets Lab with his friends, where his internal designation is LabMem No. 001. Due to an accident, he ended up crossing over to the world of Magrasea.
infoStories:
Rintaro Okabe stands 177cm tall, weighs 59kg, and has an A blood type. Due to poor nutrition, he is scrawnier than most humans of the same age. He speaks in a proud tone and believes that he is "an insane mad scientist whose intellect can influence the destiny of the world, and various governments and organizations have their eye on him".

He typically dresses in a scientist's lab coat, but in order to conform to his character of a mad scientist, said coat has been altered and does not meet professional standards due to having no buttons. From this, we can surmise that Okabe's wild and messy hairstyle is deliberately cultivated to suit this persona. This behavior is also known as "chuunibyou" in human society.

Given our current data, while Okabe is given to uttering statements that might lead to misunderstandings, he is fundamentally an ordinary undergraduate and poses no threat to the Oasis.

"95% of the collected data was filled with delusional ranting, conspiracy theories, meaningless chuuni statements, and other such data." —Oasis HR Department

Okabe comes from Akihabara, Japan, in the year 2010. However, the world of 2010, as he described it, does not entirely conform to 2010 in our records. After confirming that there was no cognitive discrepancy or recording errors, the Oasis is certain that Okabe and his colleagues come from a completely different world.

In Okabe's original world, he, Mayuri Shiina and Itaru Hashida founded the "Future Gadget Laboratory" on the second floor of the "Ohiyama Building", during which Okabe appointed himself LabMem No. 001. According to Okabe, the Future Gadgets Lab is a scientific organization whose aim is to research and develop various Future Gadgets. However, field data suggests that the lab is more of a science club of sorts.

As for the "Future Gadgets" Okabe claims to have invented, all of them contain homages and inspirations from popular culture, probably because the lab was founded in Akihabara. Their actual functions are strangely dissociated from their original conception. For example, the trigger-operated "Bit Particle Cannon" has the sole function of changing channels and cannot replace a proper remote control. The "Bamboo Helicam", while capable of aerial photography, is not stabilized and will thus rotate with the bamboo copter's spinning, making it unusable for normal photography.

Due to his severe chuunibyou syndrome, Okabe sometimes performs unusual acts, including but not limited to shouting his alias while striking a pose of dubious meaning, giving the people around him incomprehensible nicknames, worrying out loud about how the "Organization" is planning to kill him, pulling out his cell phone and pretending to have meaningful conversations, and so on.

Despite Okabe's strange behavior, he is surprisingly prudent when a situation arises. Perhaps it is due to his love of conspiracy theories, but he always considers the worst possible outcomes before acting (although said conspiracy theories are either caused by his delusions or overly far-fetched hypotheses). Thanks to his severe chuunibyou syndrome, he also has few friends in real life. Even his colleagues in the Future Gadgets Lab (his LabMems) usually play dumb or ignore his delusions when they come up. 

For that reason, despite being the ostensible "leader" of the Future Gadget Laboratory, he commands little to no authority. However, his inclination to cherish his colleagues has earned their respect instead.

When Okabe discovered that he and the Future Gadgets Lab had been transported to an unknown world line—or rather, an unknown world—he and everyone else who had experienced this could not fully accept that fact right away.

Although an endless stream of problems and difficulties soon followed, after coming to understand the situation, Okabe suddenly exploded with a strange passion and sense of purpose. In the space of just one day, he was no longer fazed by crossing over to another world. After settling down in the Oasis, his life did not change much from his previous world; most of his time was spent working on strange Future Gadgets in the lab, each of which would cause various stirs in the Oasis. Unlike in the past, however, several Dolls were influenced by his quirky personality and charm and ended up befriending him.

"Future Gadget No. 2199 Aegis Plan" —Denied!
"Mysterious Warrior vs Mad Scientist: Oneless" —Denied!
—Oasis Administrative Office Records

Even in the Oasis, Okabe continues to give the people around him interesting nicknames. For instance, the "Heavenly Twin Spirals", "Super Hacka ♀", "Tombstone Guide" and so on. In addition, Okabe always refers to the Professor as "Comrade of mine". Although Okabe has not spent that much more time with the Professor compared to the other members of the lab, the two of them are so in sync and understand each other so well that it seems as though they really are comrades who have fought side by side for a long time.

Okabe often brings his new inventions to show off to the Professor or invites the latter to join their Round Table Conferences. Although this usually results in the Professor having to clean up the mess triggered by various Future Gadgets, Okabe, with his self-directed mutterings and self-absorbed attitude (laced with a healthy dose of chuuni delusions) is the only one in all the Oasis who addresses the Professor as an equal. Perhaps the Professor also considers him a trustworthy comrade.

"Mr. Rintaro Okabe... Please don't write your fantasies into the records." —Oasis HR Department
